Generate OpenGraph Image

This image will be used when sharing WhoNow on social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.

📸 How to Capture:

  1. Method 1 (Easiest - Chrome/Edge):
    1. Click once on the dark preview above (clears any text selection so it won’t appear in the image)
    2. Press F12 to open DevTools
    3. Click the element selector tool (top left of DevTools)
    4. Click on the dark image preview
    5. Right-click the <div class="og-image"> element in the Elements panel
    6. Select "Capture node screenshot"
    7. Image will download automatically!
  2. Method 2: Click "Download as PNG" - uses html2canvas (may have issues with fonts/images)
  3. Method 3: Use a browser extension like "Full Page Screen Capture" or "Nimbus Screenshot"
  4. Method 4: Use macOS screenshot (Cmd+Shift+4) or Windows Snipping Tool to capture the image area

💡 The image is already sized at 1200x630px (standard OpenGraph dimensions)

⚠️ If Method 2 fails with "tainted canvas" error, use Method 1 (Chrome DevTools) - it's more reliable and doesn't have CORS issues!

Note: The "tainted canvas" error happens when opening HTML files directly from your computer (file://). Chrome DevTools method (Method 1) works around this limitation perfectly.
